name: lingua-edu-platform
description: 多语种在线教育平台 - 沉浸式语言学习

scripts.build: node -e "console.log('✅ LinguaEdu pre-flight: package.json OK. Checking server syntax and courses...'); const fs=require('fs'); const vm=require('vm'); const srv=fs.readFileSync('./server/index.js','utf8'); new vm.Script(srv,{filename:'server/index.js'}); const {courses}=require('./server/data/courses'); console.log('   - server/index.js syntax: OK'); console.log('   - courses.js loaded: '+courses.length+' 门课程'); const pub=require('path').join(process.cwd(),'public'); if(!fs.existsSync(pub) || !fs.existsSync(require('path').join(pub,'index.html'))){console.error('❌  public/index.html 缺失');process.exit(1);} console.log('   - public/index.html: OK'); console.log('✅ 预检查通过，准备启动服务。');"
